rights_common.path_assignment: All seven test/files paths match Files: *; none match the only later exception Files: debian/*. Assigned ISC, copyright 2005-2026 Marko Kreen.
rights_common.container_applicability: Affirmative distribution path-level ISC assignment, corroborated by contribution history; reasonable basis for an import decision, not legal warranty or operator permission.
rights_common.member_metadata_applicability: Distribution declaration has no selected-file carve-out, but no individually identified embedded-member sources/rights statement. Extension to each actual member is an engineering inference with residual third-party-content risk, NOT an established complete grant.
rights_common.grant_authority: Marko Kreen attribution aligns with named upstream contributor. No personal or exhaustive rights-chain attestation established; do not invent it.
rights_common.exceptions: Only debian/* GPL-2+ packaging exception in inspected manifest; no selected test/files exception. Absence of exceptions is not proof no third-party embedded rights exist.
notice_obligations: Preserve exact copyright and permission notice in all copies; retain full ISC disclaimer unchanged as distributed, including its literal ISC wording.
Carry exact source/version/path and rights-review reference alongside each selected fixture and derivative; do not relicense as CC0/MIT.
Do not copy packaging implementation into corpus; if later packaging files are redistributed, evaluate their GPL-2+ obligations separately.
rights_common.assessment_rule: A personalized per-file grant is not an automatic prerequisite when distribution coverage and contribution attribution are coherent. Ready means evidence supports presenting a bounded decision, not that complete member rights are certified.

history.literal_message:
New test files for rar5

Move away from shell scripts to tox+nose

historical_writer.unknown_reason: No actual historical writer identity/build/invocation records established in the inspected fixed evidence. O1 permits explicit unknowns for acquired replay only.

unknowns: Actual Debian archive/part hashes and equality with upstream Git objects.
Complete actual member bytes, metadata and source authorship; individual embedded rights-chain authority.
Native method/handler, operation, error, missing-volume/probing and repeat/drift behavior.

rights_assessment.context: rights_common applies to every exact file and every expected member; no per-member grant fabricated.
rights_assessment.reasoning: Positive path-specific distribution ISC assignment plus matching contribution author is proportionate evidence to submit this exact family for an operator import decision. No selected-path exception or contradictory attribution appears in the inspected sources. Missing personalized grant or historical writer executable alone does not force rejection. Actual all-member applicability remains a disclosed risk and inventory obligation, not a certified fact.

risks: Embedded third-party content may contradict distribution attribution; expected member names/sizes cannot exclude it.
GitHub history verified from reviewed snapshots, not freshly fetched after rate limit.
Metadata intent is not measured behavioral equivalence; family may fill only a subset of its case.
DRF-OLD.finite_next_action: After independent PASS, present exact named family and ISC notice obligations for one explicit bounded acquisition/quarantine/import decision; do not execute it on this card. Require actual byte/member inventory and review before accepted corpus status; unexpected provenance/content stops the pilot.
DRF-OLD.stop_condition: Stop this assessment after handoff. If the later decision requires stronger exact-member authority evidence, record that gap and stop; no automatic inquiry or expanded search.
DRF-OLD.decision_question: Does the operator accept the disclosed distribution-attribution/member-authority risk sufficiently to authorize only this pinned family for bounded quarantine/acquisition and subsequent rights/byte review, without corpus qualification or named-writer claims?
DRF-OLD.unresolved_evidence_question: Are all actual embedded members and their metadata original or otherwise covered by the stated ISC grant, and is any contrary notice/source attribution present? Not sent externally.
